title: Pip Watches the Plant Grow
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'au' and 'a-e'.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow perched beside a row of plant pots in the greenhouse.
Close view of one small seed resting in dark soil in a pot.
Pip the sparrow hopping in through the greenhouse door.
The pot of soil sitting plain and unchanged, nothing showing yet.
A tiny green tip just poking up out of the soil in the pot.
The small green shoot now standing taller above the soil.
Pip the sparrow hurrying in through the greenhouse door, a little late.
Pip the sparrow stopping in surprise at how big the plant has grown.
The plant now tall with several wide green leaves.
Pip the sparrow flapping his wings happily beside the tall green plant.
